**Link type:** shared pathway (Reactome:R-HSA-5628897, Reactome:R-HSA-611105, Reactome:R-HSA-9707564, Reactome:R-HSA-9864848)

This disruption leads to a shared downstream effect on cellular energy production and function, manifesting differently as the distinct phenotypes of linear skin defects with multiple congenital anomalies 2 and pancreatic insufficiency-anemia-hyperostosis syndrome.

**Why it matters:** Identifying the shared mechanistic link through mitochondrial dysfunction could pave the way for therapeutic strategies targeting mitochondrial health or specific metabolic pathways to ameliorate symptoms in both diseases. This could involve interventions aimed at improving mitochondrial efficiency or mitigating oxidative stress.
